guidanceConsulted.query: responsive documentation tables horizontal scroll keyboard accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>), sequential headings, <caption> plus <th scope='col|row'> on tables, aria-label on composite toolbars, type='button' on non-submit buttons, and explicit :focus-visible outlines.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: added <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, wrapped all three data tables in focusable .table-wrap regions with <caption>, <thead>/<tbody>, and <th scope='row|col'>, added aria-label and type='button' to the inline demo toolbar, and switched focus styling to :focus-visible.

guidanceConsulted.query: semantic html landmarks navigation callout banner accessible headings
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native semantic landmarks, role='note' for status banners, type='button' for action buttons, and tabindex='0' on scrollable <pre><code> blocks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: added <link rel='icon' type='image/svg+xml' href='/public/favicon.svg'>, role='note' on .baseline-banner, explicit type='button' on demo buttons, and tabindex='0' on all five <pre><code> blocks.

guidanceConsulted.query: progressive enhancement modern css responsive layout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rely on shared design-system tokens for light/dark contrast, use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size, min-block-size), and ensure touch targets meet 44px minimum height.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: removed duplicated legacy .doc-table inline styles in favor of /public/styles.css, added color: var(--text-black) and min-block-size: 44px on .demo-focusgroup buttons, and applied max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap.

openQuestions: Track whatwg/html PR #11723 and Open UI scoped-focusgroup behavior tokens (e.g., toolbar/tablist/menu behavior tokens vs horizontal/vertical tokens) to document any finalized HTML Standard token changes.
